title: Polynomial Functions: Division, Factor Theorem, Rational Roots, Graphs | Algebra II, Unit 5
description:
Read end behavior from degree, divide polynomials by long and synthetic division, use the remainder and factor theorems, find rational roots, apply the fundamental theorem of algebra, graph from zeros, and prove polynomial identities. Each section ends with a practice problem.
